title: 第23章 又痿了一个第24章 进入秘境
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
“对了，前辈外面有位名叫秋月的姑娘，说来给您送东西，您看？”
“带她过来吧！”
“公子，这是您要的阴魄草和元灵花！”
秋月毕恭毕敬的把青墨需要的东西交到他手上，秋月看到青墨一直在看着这两样东西默不作声，她怀疑是不是自己来晚了，让青墨等得太久？
突然青墨的声音响起：“你们都办得不错！
本公子也该离开了。”
青墨站起身来伸出剑指，向着身后的山上轻轻一划，一道剑痕出现在山顶的巨石上。
一股无形剑意贯穿天地之间，整个昊云大陆仿佛都在颤抖，整个西海之人察觉到这股冲天剑意之时都发自内心的感受到自身的渺小！
从上到下，由内而外没有一处地方不像是被锋利剑芒所抵一样！
就像蚍蜉见到参天巨树，游鱼见到海中真龙一样……
“这其中剑意，非心性坚定者不可参悟！
你们断念宫自己安排吧！”
断念宫众人一下子没缓过神来，站在旁边的秋月眼都红了！
断念宫得这位大佬留下的剑意，过不了多久断念宫就会成为整个昊云大陆第一势力！
“多谢前辈”
“多谢前辈”
“多谢前辈”
……
断念宫众高层纷纷下跪向青墨道谢，门下弟子也感觉到这冲天剑意，刚向这边看了一眼道心都差点崩坏，马上转移视线。
青墨等人直接前往中州，寒千雪向断念宫众人告别后，也跟随着青墨离开西海。

“嗯！
千雪的手法越来越娴熟，深得我心啊！”
“主人～，伦家的手法难道不好吗？”
青墨看着眼前的柳雨柔，这女帝撒娇起来也是让人骨头发麻啊！
这一路上寒千雪都自己研究出来了一整套的按摩手法，果然很有上进心！
青墨来到中州已经快一个月了，找了个院子，每天都是咸鱼状态，青墨也让寒千雪换上了晚礼服，尤其是弯腰帮青墨按摩的时候胸前澎湃根本抵挡不住，青墨常常被深渊凝视得无法自拔！
秋月也厚着脸皮跟在青墨身边，在她眼里既然大佬不赶自己走，那要想尽一切办法抱紧这跟又粗又大的大腿！
青墨想到自己有了离阳木和妖藤树的树枝，还差一些东西就能做把木剑了，还是自己找材料自己做更舒服一些。
“走！
咱们去看看中州最中心的城池里有没有什么能看得上眼的！
也咸鱼挺久了！”
“宿主，你的欠款什么时候结清啊～？”
（′???）σ
青墨又从系统里拿了很多现代的制服给自己两个女仆，系统催青墨结账的时候都像求大爷一样。
“哎呀！
统子不就是几件衣服吗？你至于吗？”
ㄟ（▔，▔）ㄏ
“至于，就至于！
什么几件衣服？自从咱俩合在一起你就结了半次账！
还是只结了帮你女仆换体质的！”

━┳━━┳━
“那这样，下次再穿越的时候，我把那个世界有价值的东西都弄来还款怎么样？”
“真的？”
content_en:
"By the way, senior, there is a girl named Qiuyue outside, and she said she would give you something, do you think?"
"Bring her here!"
"Sir, these are the Yin Po Grass and Yuan Ling Flower you want!"
Qiuyue respectfully handed Qingmo what he needed into his hands. Qiuyue saw that Qingmo had been looking at these two things silently. She wondered if she was late and made Qingmo wait too long?
Suddenly Qing Mo's voice sounded: "You all did a good job!
It's time for me to leave. "
Qing Mo stood up and stretched out his sword finger, lightly swiping towards the mountain behind him, and a sword mark appeared on the boulder on the top of the mountain.
An invisible sword intent penetrated between heaven and earth, and the entire Haoyun Continent seemed to be trembling. When the people in the West Sea noticed this soaring sword intent, they felt their own insignificance from the bottom of their hearts!
From top to bottom, from the inside out, there is no place that does not feel like it is being struck by a sharp sword!
Just like an earthworm seeing a giant tree, a swimming fish seeing a real dragon in the sea...
"The sword intention in this cannot be understood by those who are not firm in character!
You can make your own arrangements in the Duan Nian Palace! "
Everyone in the Duan Nian Palace could not calm down for a while, and Qiu Yue standing next to her had her eyes turned red!
Duan Nian Palace has obtained the sword intention left by this big boss. Soon Duan Nian Palace will become the number one force in the entire Haoyun Continent!
"Thank you, senior"
"Thank you, senior"
"Thank you, senior"
…
The senior officials of Duan Nian Palace knelt down to express their gratitude to Qing Mo. The disciples also felt the soaring sword intent, and their hearts almost broke as soon as they took one look here, so they immediately looked away.
Qing Mo and others went directly to Zhongzhou. After Han Qianxue said goodbye to everyone in Duan Nian Palace, she followed Qing Mo and left the West Sea.
"Hmm!
Qianxue's techniques are becoming more and more skillful, and she won my heart! "
"Master~, aren't the Lun family's methods bad?"
Qing Mo looked at Liu Yurou in front of him. This empress's coquettish behavior made people's bones go numb!
Along the way, Han Qianxue has developed a complete set of massage techniques on her own, and she is indeed very motivated!
It has been almost a month since Qing Mo came to Zhongzhou. He found a yard and was in a state of ecstasy every day. Qing Mo also asked Han Qianxue to change into an evening dress. Especially when he bent down to massage Qing Mo, the surging sensation in his chest was unbearable. Qing Mo was often stared into the abyss and couldn't extricate himself!
Qiu Yue shamelessly followed Qing Mo. In her eyes, since the boss wouldn't drive her away, she would try her best to hug those thick and big thighs!
Qing Mo thought that he had the branches of Liyang wood and demon vine tree, and still needed some things to make a wooden sword. It would be more comfortable to find the materials and make it himself.
"Go!
Let’s go see if there’s anything interesting to see in the city at the center of Zhongzhou!
I’ve been eating salted fish for a long time! "
"Host, when will your debt be settled~?"
(′???)σ
Qing Mo also got a lot of modern uniforms from the system for his two maids. When the system urged Qing Mo to pay the bill, it was like begging an uncle.
"Ouch!
Isn’t it just a few pieces of clothing? Are you concerned? "
ㄟ(▔,▔)ㄏ
“As for that, that’s it!
What clothes? You've settled half of the bills since we got together!
Or I only married the one who helped your maid change her physique! "
━┳━━┳━
"Well, next time I travel through time, how about I bring back all the valuable things from that world to repay the debt?"
"Really?"
